sections.purpose: Introduce the product and pricing options.
sections.copy: UptimeGuard ensures your services stay up and running with reliable uptime monitoring. Choose your plan and start protecting your digital infrastructure today.

sections.purpose: Display three pricing tiers with features and CTAs.
sections.copy: Starter: $15/mo — Basic uptime monitoring for small projects. Pro: $49/mo — Advanced features for growing teams. Team: $149/mo — Enterprise-grade monitoring for large-scale operations. Recommended: Pro

Feature | Starter | Pro | Team
---|---|---|---
Uptime Monitoring | ✔ | ✔ | ✔
Custom Alerts | ✔ | ✔ | ✔
Team Collaboration | ✔ | ✔ | ✔
Advanced Reporting | ✔ | ✔ | ✔
24/7 Support | ✔ | ✔ | ✔
Custom SLA | ✔ | ✔ | ✔

What payment methods do you accept? | Credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfer.
Can I cancel anytime? | Yes, with a 30-day notice period.
Is there a free trial? | Yes, 14 days of free access.
What happens if I exceed my SLA? | You’ll receive a 10% discount on the next month’s billing.
Can I upgrade my plan at any time? | Yes, and your new plan will apply immediately.
